correctness.rationale: For the flat two-site cyclic opening, generic-order derivatives are row-selector matrices with column multiplicities at most three. Orthogonal centering yields the unrestricted sqrt(3) upper bound. Equality in the two inequalities holds precisely when two columns each have multiplicity three: choose opposite perturbations at those sources. This needs four distinct strict local peaks, impossible on cycles shorter than eight. A six-support explicit perturbation realizes equality on every cycle of length at least eight; the two-site case is constant and the monotone-base one-peak construction gives strict expansion for every size from three up. Piecewise linear continuity extends chamber results to all real input pairs. Embedded exact rational checker enumerated selector masks through eight sites, sharp witnesses through 60 sites and 14500 rational pair inequalities. The finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-dimension proof.
